jobs.title: Engineering Planner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for an experienced Maintenance Planner / Scheduler who confidently coordinates maintenance and troubleshooting activities in a GMP-regulated environment, effectively collaborates with production and workshop teams, and brings strong expertise in maintenance planning, SAP PM, and resource coordination, in order to ensure reliable, compliant, and on-time execution of maintenance activities for facilities, utilities, and equipment.

Start date: 01.06.2026
End date: 31.10.2026
Workload:100%
Contract Type: Contracting
Location: Visp

Your Tasks:

• Create and maintain maintenance schedules for facilities, utilities, and equipment

• Ensure maintenance tasks are completed on time and escalate delays when required

• Coordinate manpower, resources, and external contractors

• Manage procurement and allocation of spare parts, materials, and consumables

• Prepare KPI reports and maintenance performance reports

• Ensure all maintenance activities are performed safely and in compliance with GMP requirements

• Continuously improve planning and scheduling processes

Your Profile:

• Technical or engineering qualification (HND/HNC or equivalent)

• Experience in maintenance planning and engineering maintenance activities

• Ideally experience in pharmaceutical, GMP, or highly regulated environments

• Strong knowledge of maintenance planning and scheduling processes

• SAP PM experience required

• Fluent in German and English

jobs.title: ICT Infrastructure Engineer (Microsoft & Network) 80 bis 100 % (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Position genau das Richtige für Sie sein.

Unser Auftraggeber ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen der Sportbranche. Gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Infrastrukturteam sorgen Sie dafür, dass eine moderne Enterprise-IT zuverlässig, sicher und zukunftsfähig bleibt.

Ihre Aufgaben:

Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung einer internationalen IT-Infrastruktur. Dabei arbeiten Sie sowohl im Microsoft-Umfeld als auch im Enterprise Networking und bringen sich aktiv in Infrastruktur- und Security-Projekte ein.

Ihr Tätigkeitsgebiet umfasst unter anderem:

• Weiterentwicklung der Microsoft 365-, Azure- und Hybrid-Umgebung

• Betrieb und Optimierung der Windows Server- und Active Directory-Landschaft

• Weiterentwicklung der Enterprise-Netzwerkinfrastruktur mit Switching, VLANs, WLAN, Firewalls und Network Access Control

• Planung und Umsetzung von Infrastruktur-, Netzwerk- und Security-Projekten

• Mitarbeit bei der Weiterentwicklung der IT- und Security-Architektur

• Evaluation neuer Technologien und technischer Lösungen

• Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Fachbereichen sowie externen Partnern

• Unterstützung des 2nd und 3rd Level Supports bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragestellungen

Ihr Profil:

Sie bringen mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Infrastrukturbereich mit und bewegen sich sicher in modernen Microsoft-Umgebungen oder im Enterprise Networking.

Sie müssen nicht jede eingesetzte Technologie perfekt beherrschen. Entscheidend sind Ihre Bereitschaft, sich weiterzuentwickeln, und Ihr Interesse an einer vielseitigen Infrastrukturrolle.

Idealerweise bringen Sie Folgendes mit:

• Erfahrung als System Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer oder Network Engineer

• Gute Kenntnisse im Microsoft-Umfeld (Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server oder Active Directory)

• Erfahrung im Enterprise Networking oder Interesse, sich in diesem Bereich weiterzuentwickeln

• Erfahrung mit Infrastrukturprojekten

• Cisco-, Aruba-, VMware- oder PowerShell-Kenntnisse sind willkommen, aber kein Muss

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Persönlich überzeugen Sie durch:

• Teamfähigkeit und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit

• Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Analytisches und vernetztes Denken

• Kommunikationsstärke

• Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

Das erwartet Sie:

Diese Position bietet deutlich mehr als den klassischen Betrieb einer IT-Infrastruktur.

Freuen Sie sich auf:

• Viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum

• Abwechslungsreiche Infrastruktur- und Digitalisierungsprojekte

• Moderne Microsoft-Cloud- und Enterprise-Netzwerktechnologien

• Ein eingespieltes Infrastrukturteam mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

• Ein internationales Umfeld innerhalb der Sportbranche

• Moderne Büroräumlichkeiten direkt beim Bahnhof

• Bis zu zwei Homeoffice-Tage pro Woche

• 40-Stunden-Woche

• 25 Ferientage sowie zusätzliche freie Tage zwischen Weihnachten und Neujahr

• Attraktive Weiterbildungsangebote und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

• Mitarbeitenden-Events sowie die Möglichkeit, ausgewählte Sportveranstaltungen mitzuerleben

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione sarà giusta per voi.

Il nostro cliente è un'azienda attiva a livello internazionale nel settore sportivo. Per rafforzare il team di infrastrutture, stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata come ICT System & Network Engineer.

I loro compiti:

Insieme a un team di infrastrutture consolidato, si assumono la responsabilità di un panorama IT moderno con circa 800 clienti.

In particolare, i suoi compiti includono:

• Amministrazione e ulteriore sviluppo dell'ambiente Microsoft 365 e Azure

• Supporto per le infrastrutture ibride di Windows Server e Active Directory

• Operazione e ottimizzazione dell'infrastruttura di rete aziendale

• Amministrazione di firewall, controllo di accesso alla rete e altri componenti di rete

• Pianificazione e realizzazione di progetti infrastrutturali e di rete

• Ulteriori sviluppi dell'architettura IT e della sicurezza

• Valutazione delle nuove tecnologie e soluzioni hardware e software

• Cooperazione con partner esterni e fornitori di servizi

• Supporto della IT Service Desk per problemi complessi ed escalation

Il tuo profilo:

Hanno diversi anni di esperienza nel settore delle infrastrutture ICT e sono sicuri in ambienti di sistema e di rete.

Idealmente, avete:

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale come ingegnere del sistema ICT o ingegnere di rete

• Istruzione o studi di scienze informatiche

• Ottima conoscenza degli ambienti Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server e Active Directory ibridi

• Esperienza con networking aziendale e progetti di rete e infrastrutture

• La conoscenza delle tecnologie Cisco o Aruba è un vantaggio

• Esperienza con VMware e PowerShell è un plus

• Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese

Personalmente, si convince da:

• Lavoro di squadra e godimento della collaborazione

• Iniziativa e responsabilità

• pensiero analitico e in rete

• Forza di comunicazione

• Metodo di lavoro strutturato e orientato alla soluzione

Cosa vi aspetta:

• Un compito versatile e responsabile con un sacco di libertà creativa

• Collaborazione in un team di infrastrutture collegiali e consolidati

• Moderne tecnologie cloud, server e di rete Microsoft

• Responsabilità per un panorama IT moderno in un'azienda internazionale

• Lavoro ibrido con fino a due giorni lavorativi a settimana

• Posto di lavoro moderno direttamente alla stazione di Zug

• Ore lavorative flessibili su una settimana di 40 ore

• 25 giorni festivi e giorni liberi aggiuntivi tra Natale e Capodanno

• Possibilità di formazione e sviluppo individuali

• Prestazioni sociali interessanti e numerosi vantaggi

• Ambiente di lavoro sportivo e dinamico con la possibilità di partecipare a eventi aziendali e sportivi selezionati
descriptionByLocale.en:
Position will be just right for you.

Our client is an internationally active company in the sports industry. To strengthen the infrastructure team, we are looking for a committed personality as an ICT System & Network Engineer.

Their tasks:

Together with a well-established infrastructure team, they assume responsibility for a modern IT landscape with around 800 clients.

In particular, its tasks include:

• Administration and further development of the Microsoft 365 and Azure environment

• Support for hybrid Windows Server and Active Directory infrastructures

• Operation and optimization of enterprise network infrastructure

• Administration of firewalls, network access control and other network components

• Planning and implementation of infrastructure and network projects

• Further development of the IT and security architecture

• Evaluation of new technologies and hardware and software solutions

• Cooperation with external partners and service providers

• Support of the IT Service Desk for complex issues and escalations

Ideally, you have:

• Several years of professional experience as an ICT System Engineer or Network Engineer

• Computer science education or studies

• Very good knowledge of Microsoft 365, Azure, Windows Server and hybrid Active Directory environments

• Knowledge of Cisco or Aruba technologies is an advantage

• Very good knowledge of German and English

Personally, you convince by:

• Teamwork and enjoyment of collaboration

• Own initiative and responsibility

• Analytical and networked thinking

• Communication strength

• Structured and solution-oriented working method

• A versatile and responsible task with a lot of creative freedom

• Collaboration in a collegial and well-established infrastructure team

• Modern Microsoft cloud, server and network technologies

• Responsibility for a modern IT landscape in an international company

• Hybrid work with up to two home office days per week

• Modern workplace directly at Zug station

• Flexible working hours on a 40-hour week

• 25 holiday days and additional free days between Christmas and New Year

• Individual training and development opportunities

• Attractive social benefits and numerous benefits

• Sports and dynamic working environment with the opportunity to participate in selected corporate and sporting events

jobs.description:
Position gestalten Sie die Weiterentwicklung einer zentralen CRM und Power Platform Umgebung. Sie verbinden fundiertes Architekturverständnis mit konkreter technischer Umsetzung und sorgen dafür, dass Anforderungen in skalierbare, nachhaltige und gut integrierte Lösungen überführt werden.

Die Position eignet sich besonders für Personen, die Architektur nicht nur konzipieren, sondern Lösungen auch selbst auf der Plattform realisieren möchten.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sie gestalten Lösungsarchitekturen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 und der Microsoft Power Platform.

• Sie analysieren fachliche Anforderungen und überführen diese in strukturierte, skalierbare und nachhaltige Lösungen.

• Sie konzipieren und entwickeln Datenmodelle sowie Prozesslogiken weiter.

• Sie stellen das Zusammenspiel und die Wartbarkeit unterschiedlicher Lösungen innerhalb der Plattform sicher.

• Sie setzen Lösungen selbst auf Dynamics 365 und der Power Platform um.

• Sie entwickeln Workflows und Automatisierungen mit den Möglichkeiten der Power Platform.

• Sie definieren und steuern Datenflüsse zwischen verschiedenen Systemen.

• Sie konzipieren und realisieren Integrationen und Erweiterungen.

• Bei komplexeren Anforderungen können auch Azure Functions zum Einsatz kommen.

• Sie entwickeln die Plattform strukturell weiter und etablieren Standards sowie wiederverwendbare Lösungen.

• Sie arbeiten eng mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.

Ihr Profil

• Sie verfügen über fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM .

• Sie bringen sehr gute Kenntnisse der Microsoft Power Platform mit und haben entsprechende Lösungen bereits selbst umgesetzt.

• Sie haben Erfahrung im Solution Design oder in der Solution Architecture und können fachliche Anforderungen in technisch konsistente Lösungen übersetzen.

• Sie verfügen über ein gutes Verständnis von Systemarchitekturen, Datenstrukturen und Datenmodellen .

• Sie verstehen das Zusammenspiel von Systemen sowie die damit verbundenen Integrationen und Datenflüsse .

• Sie arbeiten gerne konzeptionell und setzen Lösungen gleichzeitig auch selbst technisch um.

• Erfahrung mit Workflows, Low Code Automatisierung und Integrationslösungen ist von Vorteil.

• Kenntnisse im Azure Umfeld, insbesondere mit Azure Functions , sind ebenfalls von Vorteil.

• Sie kommunizieren klar und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und technischen Stakeholdern zusammen.

Was Sie erwartet

Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle innerhalb eines spezialisierten Plattform Teams und erhalten die Möglichkeit, die CRM und Power Platform Landschaft aktiv mitzugestalten.

Dabei bewegen Sie sich nicht in einer reinen Architekturrolle. Sie entwickeln Lösungsansätze, treffen strukturelle Designentscheidungen und begleiten diese bis in die konkrete Umsetzung.

Sie arbeiten innerhalb eines definierten technischen Rahmens und verfügen gleichzeitig über Gestaltungsspielraum bei der fachlichen und strukturellen Ausarbeitung der Lösungen.

Das Unternehmen bietet ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit grundsätzlich drei Präsenztagen am Standort in der Region Frauenfeld und zwei Homeoffice Tagen. Projektabhängig können fixe oder zusätzliche Präsenztage erforderlich sein.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizionate l'ulteriore sviluppo di un ambiente centrale CRM e Power Platform. Combinano una solida comprensione architettonica con una concreta implementazione tecnica e assicurano che i requisiti siano trasformati in soluzioni scalabili, sostenibili e ben integrate.

La posizione è particolarmente adatta per le persone che non solo progettano l'architettura, ma vogliono anche realizzare soluzioni stesse sulla piattaforma.

I loro compiti

• Essi progettano architetture di soluzione basate su Microsoft Dynamics 365 e la piattaforma di Microsoft Power.

• Essi analizzano i requisiti professionali e li trasformano in soluzioni strutturate, scalabili e sostenibili.

• Progetterai e svilupperai ulteriori modelli di dati e logiche di processo.

• Garantiscono l'interazione e la manutenzione di diverse soluzioni all'interno della piattaforma.

• Essi implementano soluzioni stesse su Dynamics 365 e la Power Platform.

• Svilupperai flussi di lavoro e automazione utilizzando la piattaforma di alimentazione.

• Definiscono e controllano i flussi di dati tra diversi sistemi.

• Progettano e realizzano integrazioni e estensioni.

• Per esigenze più complesse, le funzioni Azure possono anche essere utilizzate.

• Sviluppano ulteriormente la piattaforma strutturalmente e stabiliscono standard e soluzioni riutilizzabili.

• Lavorano a stretto contatto con diverse aree specializzate e contatti tecnici.

Il tuo profilo

• Hai una profonda esperienza pratica con Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

• Essi portano una buona conoscenza della piattaforma di Microsoft Power e hanno già implementato le soluzioni stesse.

• Hai esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni o nell'architettura di soluzioni e puoi tradurre requisiti tecnici in soluzioni tecnicamente coerenti.

• Hanno una buona comprensione di architetture di sistema, strutture di dati e modelli di dati.

• Essi comprendono l'interazione dei sistemi, nonché le relative integrazioni e flussi di dati.

• A loro piace lavorare concettualmente e allo stesso tempo implementare soluzioni stesse tecnicamente.

• L'esperienza con flussi di lavoro, soluzioni di automazione e integrazione a basso codice è un vantaggio.

• La conoscenza nell'ambiente Azure, soprattutto con le funzioni Azure, è anche un vantaggio.

• Essi comunicano chiaramente e godono di lavorare con diverse aree specializzate e stakeholder tecnici.

Cosa aspettarsi

Si assume un ruolo centrale all'interno di un team di piattaforma specializzato e ottenere l'opportunità di modellare attivamente il paesaggio CRM e Power Platform.

Non si muove in un ruolo architettonico puro. Sviluppano soluzioni, prendono decisioni di progettazione strutturale e li accompagnano in attuazione concreta.

Essi lavorano in un quadro tecnico definito e allo stesso tempo hanno spazio per la manovra nello sviluppo tecnico e strutturale delle soluzioni.

L'azienda offre un modello di lavoro ibrido con fondamentalmente tre giorni di presenza presso il sito nella regione di Frauenfeld e due giorni di ufficio casalingo. A seconda del progetto, possono essere richiesti giorni di presenza fissi o aggiuntivi.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Position you design the further development of a central CRM and Power Platform environment. They combine sound architectural understanding with concrete technical implementation and ensure that requirements are transformed into scalable, sustainable and well-integrated solutions.

The position is particularly suitable for people who not only design architecture, but also want to realize solutions themselves on the platform.

Their tasks

• They design solution architectures based on Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Microsoft Power Platform.

• They analyze professional requirements and transform them into structured, scalable and sustainable solutions.

• You will design and develop further data models and process logics.

• They ensure the interaction and maintainability of different solutions within the platform.

• They implement solutions themselves on Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform.

• You will develop workflows and automations using the power platform.

• They define and control data flows between different systems.

• They design and realize integrations and extensions.

• For more complex requirements, Azure functions can also be used.

• They further develop the platform structurally and establish standards and reusable solutions.

• They work closely with different specialist areas and technical contacts.

Your profile

• You have deep practical experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.

• They bring very good knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform and have already implemented corresponding solutions themselves.

• You have experience in solution design or solution architecture and can translate technical requirements into technically consistent solutions.

• They have a good understanding of system architectures, data structures and data models.

• They understand the interaction of systems as well as the associated integrations and data flows.

• They like to work conceptually and at the same time implement solutions themselves technically.

• Experience with workflows, low code automation and integration solutions is an advantage.

• Knowledge in the Azure environment, especially with Azure Functions, is also an advantage.

• They communicate clearly and enjoy working with different specialist areas and technical stakeholders.

What to expect

You take on a central role within a specialized platform team and get the opportunity to actively shape the CRM and Power Platform landscape.

You do not move in a pure architectural role. They develop solutions, make structural design decisions and accompany them into concrete implementation.

They work within a defined technical framework and at the same time have room for manoeuvre in the technical and structural development of the solutions.

The company offers a hybrid working model with basically three days of presence at the site in the Frauenfeld region and two home office days. Depending on the project, fixed or additional attendance days may be required.

jobs.description:
For our client Roche Diagnostics in Rotkreuz, we are looking for an experienced Solution Engineer / Linux Expert (m/f/d) . In this highly technical role, you will take ownership of a custom Debian-based Linux distribution that forms the foundation of next-generation medical devices.

Start date: asap / latest Start date: 01.10.26

End date: 1 year (with option to extend)

Workload: 80-100%

Contract Type: Contracting

Extension: Possible

Location: Canton Zug

Home Office: 50% onsite, home office possible, flexible working hours

Tasks & Responsibilities

• Architect and Engineer our Core OS Platform: Take ownership of our custom Debian-based distribution. This includes everything from kernel customization and driver integration to the creation, maintenance, and optimization of Debian packages.

• Master the Build and Release Pipeline: Evolve and improve the infrastructure and processes used to build, test, and release our Linux distribution, ensuring reliability and reproducibility.

• Be the Ultimate Escalation Point: Act as the go-to expert for complex, low-level system issues. Perform deep-dive troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis across both software and hardware.

• Consult and Empower Development Teams: Guide internal project teams on how to best leverage the Roche Linux platform.

• Proactively Drive Improvement: Constantly seek out opportunities to enhance our distribution, tools, and processes. Whether it's improving system performance, strengthening security, or automating a complex workflow, you will be expected to identify needs and champion solutions.

Must Haves

• Deep, Hands-On Linux Mastery, 10+ years: You are a seasoned professional who is comfortable across the entire Linux stack.

• Custom Distribution Engineering: Proven, extensive experience building, modifying, or maintaining a customized Linux distribution, with a strong preference for Debian, for example using tools like debootstrap, molior and aptly.

• Expertise in Debian Packaging: You don't just apt-get install. You can create, patch, and maintain .deb packages from scratch, understanding policy, dependencies and best practices.

• Strong Scripting and Automation Skills: Fluency in Python and Shell scripting is essential for building tools and automating system tasks.

• Fundamental Systems Knowledge: A solid grasp of operating system theory, including process management, memory and filesystems, software build systems such as make and CMake, and the full testing and packaging lifecycle.

• Languages: Advanced English is mandatory; German is a welcome bonus.

Nice to Have

• Proficiency in a systems programming language like C or C++.

• Experience with embedded systems, the ARM platform, hardware drivers, and low-level hardware/software integration.

• Knowledge of modern infrastructure: virtualization with KVM, containers such as Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code with Terraform.

• Experience with cloud platforms, for example AWS.

jobs.title: Cold Chain Project Coordinator (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client, a CMO company we are looking for a Cold Chain Project Coordinator.

It is a contract until 31 Decemeber 2026.

Location: Visp

Duration: until 31.12.2025

Responsibilities:

The Cold Chain Project Coordinator / Cold Chain Expert role combines strong project coordination capabilities with specialized expertise in temperature-controlled supply chain processes, cold chain solutions, and compliant logistics operations. The incumbent supports the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Cold Chain projects and solutions, ensuring that temperature-sensitive products are handled, stored, and transported in line with quality, regulatory, and business requirements.

Acting as a key point of coordination for cross-functional project teams, the role ensures reliable execution of Cold Chain initiatives, alignment with stakeholders, and timely delivery of solutions that improve product protection, operational robustness, and supply chain performance.

This includes coordination, decision-making support, communication, documentation, and governance in accordance with project management principles and Cold Chain best practices. The role contributes to the development and implementation of fit-for-purpose Cold Chain solutions across the Supply Chain network, with responsibilities depending on current business needs.

• Maintaining comprehensive Cold Chain project documentation, implementation plans, validation-relevant records, and progress reports.

• Supporting the preparation of project proposals, business cases, timelines, and implementation schedules for Cold Chain initiatives.

• Coordinating quality and compliance controls to ensure Cold Chain deliverables meet regulatory, GMP/GDP, customer, and internal requirements.

• Monitoring and reporting project progress, risks, deviations, issues, and mitigation actions related to temperature-controlled logistics.

• Acting as a central point of contact for Cold Chain project status, solution readiness, and stakeholder communication.

• Organizing, attending, and actively contributing to stakeholder meetings, project governance forums, and cross-functional Cold Chain workshops.

• Ensuring project milestones and deadlines are met, identifying required adjustments to keep Cold Chain solutions on track.

• Analyzing risks and opportunities related to temperature excursions, packaging concepts, transport lanes, storage conditions, and operational handovers.

• Supporting the Supply Chain team in designing and implementing Cold Chain solutions on time, within cost expectations, and according to required quality standards.

• Collaborating closely with network peers, Quality, Logistics, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, external service providers, and other stakeholders to ensure robust end-to-end Cold Chain performance.

•

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, likely in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations, Logistics, or a related field.

• Experience coordinating projects, timelines, deliverables, actions, risks, and stakeholders.

• Experience in supply chain in pharma, biotech or CMO industry.

Per il nostro cliente, una società CMO stiamo cercando un coordinatore del progetto Cold Chain.

È un contratto fino al 31 dicembre 2026.

Posizione: Visp

Durata: fino al 31.12.2025

Responsabilità:

Il ruolo di Cold Chain Project Coordinator / Cold Chain Expert combina forti capacità di coordinamento del progetto con competenze specialistiche nei processi di supply chain a temperatura controllata, soluzioni a catena fredda e operazioni logistiche conformi. L'incumbent supporta la progettazione, l'implementazione e il miglioramento continuo dei progetti e delle soluzioni Cold Chain, garantendo che i prodotti sensibili alla temperatura siano gestiti, conservati e trasportati in linea con i requisiti di qualità, regolazione e business.

Essendo un punto chiave di coordinamento per i team di progetto interfunzionali, il ruolo assicura l'esecuzione affidabile delle iniziative Cold Chain, l'allineamento con le parti interessate e la consegna tempestiva di soluzioni che migliorano la protezione dei prodotti, la robustezza operativa e le prestazioni della supply chain.

Ciò include il coordinamento, il supporto decisionale, la comunicazione, la documentazione e la governance in conformità con i principi di gestione del progetto e le best practice di Cold Chain. Il ruolo contribuisce allo sviluppo e all'implementazione di soluzioni di Cold Chain fit-for-purpose in tutta la rete Supply Chain, con responsabilità a seconda delle attuali esigenze aziendali.

• Mantenere la documentazione completa del progetto Cold Chain, i piani di implementazione, i record rilevanti per la validazione e i report sui progressi.

• Sostenere la preparazione di proposte di progetto, casi di business, tempi e programmi di attuazione per le iniziative Cold Chain.

• Coordinamento dei controlli di qualità e conformità per garantire che i prodotti Cold Chain soddisfino i requisiti normativi, GMP/GDP, cliente e interni.

• Monitoraggio e reportistica dei progressi del progetto, dei rischi, delle deviazioni, dei problemi e delle azioni di mitigazione legate alla logistica controllata dalla temperatura.

The incumbent supports the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Cold Chain projects and solutions, ensuring that temperature-sensitive products are handled, stored, and transported in line with quality, regulatory, and business requirements.

Acting as a key point of coordination for cross-functional project teams, the role ensures reliable execution of Cold Chain initiatives, alignment with stakeholders, and timely delivery of solutions that improve product protection, operational robustness, and supply chain performance.

• Organizing, attending, and actively contributing to stakeholder meetings, project governance forums, and cross-functional Cold Chain workshops.

jobs.description:
For our client in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a The Delivery Manager who will be responsible for the deployment of strategic procurement initiatives within a designated manufacturing network, ensuring alignment with Category Management strategies. This role acts as a key business partner to the site/network and encompasses supplier management (including negotiation, contracting, and performance monitoring), as well as handling escalations from business stakeholders. The Delivery Manager plays a key part in driving cost savings, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to optimize value for Operations.

Contract duration: 12 months

Home Office : 2 days per week

Travel: up to 20% - Europe

Responsibilities:

•
 Strategic procurement initiatives - Deployment of strategic procurement initiatives within a manufacturing network ensuring a focus on efficiency, compliance, and the quality of customer service.

•
 Understand end-user requirements as received directly or indirectly

•
 Leverage the applicable category guidance documents and procurement knowledge to determine the best method for driving value in meeting the request

•
 Coordination of the sourcing process (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs) for the delivery of sourcing activity, incl. the application of eSourcing tools. Support the implementation of new processes, policies, and technologies

•
 Execute support requests, applying continuous improvement methodologies where possible

•
 Ensure compliance to applicable policies, standards, and operating procedures to maintain the organization’s right to operate

•
 Communicate the status, progress, and outcomes of procurement activities

•
 Support the creation and review of relevant purchasing documentation

•
 Maintain information flows – Responsible for maintaining strong information flows back to the Category Management teams in the event of:

•
 High-value or non-standard requests (i.e. those not covered by guidelines)

•
 Opportunities to aggregate demand and generate additional leverage

•
 Regular submission of operations data and requirements to develop new strategies

•
 Collaborate with support functions – Collaborate on an as-needed basis with relevant business support functions (e.g. Accounts Payable) to drive operational efficiencies and maximum value-add to the business

•
 Monitor targets and KPIs – Ensure that Direct Procurement Operations targets and metrics on customer service are delivered. Track and monitor these metrics where required, and escalate issues as they arise

•
 Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) – Support CSR initiatives related to (candidate) suppliers, e.g. supplier diversity, anti-bribery, animal welfare, etc.

•
 Training – Perform continuous professional development activities and ensure up-to-date training in processes and systems relevant to the position

Requirements:

•
 University degree, with a business-related degree, preferably a post-graduate business qualification

•
 Business level fluency in English. Competence or fluency in other languages is strongly encouraged.

•
 3+ years of procurement experience with experience in basic contracting, business enterprise systems, and spot buying

•
 Experience or demonstrated understanding in supporting cost reduction and value improvement programs

•
 Experience with enterprise systems and procure to-pay tools and eSourcing tools is desired

•
 Good communication skills and demonstrated understanding of translating business requirements into procurement specifications with customer service in mind

•
 Knowledgeable in systems and processes for efficient management of contract documentation, templates and processing tools (e.g. eSourcing, eAuction)

•
 Desirably professional purchasing (e.g. CIPS, ISM) or Finance related licenses or certifications

Il Delivery Manager svolge un ruolo chiave nel risparmio dei costi di guida e nell'attuazione di iniziative di miglioramento continuo per ottimizzare il valore delle operazioni.

Durata del contratto: 12 mesi

Home Office: 2 giorni alla settimana

Viaggi: fino al 20% - Europa

Responsabilità:

•
 Iniziative di approvvigionamento strategico - Distribuzione di iniziative di approvvigionamento strategico all'interno di una rete manifatturiera che garantisce un focus sull'efficienza, la conformità e la qualità del servizio clienti.

•
 Comprendere i requisiti degli utenti finali come ricevuti direttamente o indirettamente

•
 Leva i documenti di orientamento della categoria applicabili e le conoscenze di approvvigionamento per determinare il metodo migliore per il valore di guida nel soddisfare la richiesta

•
 Coordinamento del processo di approvvigionamento (RfIs, RfQs, RfPs) per la fornitura di attività di approvvigionamento, incl. l'applicazione di strumenti di eSourcing. Sostenere l'attuazione di nuovi processi, politiche e tecnologie

•
 Esegui richieste di supporto, applicando metodologie di miglioramento continuo ove possibile

•
 Assicurarsi la conformità alle politiche, agli standard e alle procedure operative applicabili per mantenere il diritto dell’organizzazione di operare

•
 Comunicare lo stato, il progresso e i risultati delle attività di approvvigionamento

•
 Sostenere la creazione e la revisione della documentazione di acquisto rilevante

 Opportunità per aggregare la domanda e generare una leva aggiuntiva

 Presentazione regolare dei dati operativi e dei requisiti per sviluppare nuove strategie

Reisen: bis zu 20% - Europa

 Strategische Beschaffungsinitiativen - Bereitstellung strategischer Beschaffungsinitiativen innerhalb eines Fertigungsnetzwerks, um einen Fokus auf Effizienz, Compliance und die Qualität des Kundenservice zu gewährleisten.

•
 Endbenutzeranforderungen als direkt oder indirekt erhalten verstehen

 Nutzen Sie die anwendbaren Kategorieleitfäden und das Beschaffungswissen, um die beste Methode zur Wertsteigerung bei der Erfüllung der Anforderung zu ermitteln

•

 Status, Fortschritt und Ergebnisse von Beschaffungsaktivitäten kommunizieren

 Möglichkeiten, die Nachfrage zu aggregieren und zusätzliche Hebelwirkung zu generieren

 Regelmäßige Übermittlung von Betriebsdaten und Anforderungen zur Entwicklung neuer Strategien

 Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und demonstriertes Verständnis für die Übersetzung von Geschäftsanforderungen in Beschaffungsspezifikationen mit Blick auf den Kundenservice

Ce rôle est un partenaire commercial clé du site ou du réseau et englobe la gestion des fournisseurs (y compris la négociation, la passation de marchés et la surveillance du rendement), ainsi que la gestion des hausses de la part des intervenants commerciaux. Le gestionnaire de la prestation joue un rôle clé dans la réalisation d'économies et la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives d'amélioration continue pour optimiser la valeur des opérations.

Durée du contrat : 12 mois

Home Office : 2 jours par semaine

Voyages: jusqu'à 20% - Europe

Responsabilités :

•
 Initiatives stratégiques en matière d'approvisionnement - Mise en oeuvre d'initiatives stratégiques en matière d'approvisionnement au sein d'un réseau de fabrication afin de mettre l'accent sur l'efficience, la conformité et la qualité du service à la clientèle.

•
 Comprendre les exigences de l'utilisateur final telles que reçues directement ou indirectement

•
 Mettre à profit les documents d'orientation de la catégorie applicable et les connaissances en matière d'approvisionnement pour déterminer la meilleure méthode de calcul de la valeur de conduite pour répondre à la demande

•
 Coordination du processus d'approvisionnement (RfI, RfQ, RfP) pour la prestation des activités d'approvisionnement, y compris : l'application des outils eSourcing. Appuyer la mise en oeuvre de nouveaux processus, politiques et technologies

•
 Exécuter les demandes de soutien, en appliquant des méthodes d'amélioration continue si possible

•
 Assurer la conformité aux politiques, aux normes et aux procédures opérationnelles applicables pour maintenir le droit d'exploitation de l'organisation

•
 Communiquer l'état, les progrès et les résultats des activités d'approvisionnement

•
 Appuyer la création et l'examen de documents d'achat pertinents

•
 Maintenir la circulation de l'information – Assurer la bonne circulation de l'information à l'intention des équipes de gestion de catégorie en cas de :

•
 Demandes de grande valeur ou non standard (c'est-à-dire non couvertes par les lignes directrices)

•
 Possibilités d'agréger la demande et de générer un effet de levier supplémentaire

•
 Présentation régulière des données opérationnelles et des exigences pour l'élaboration de nouvelles stratégies

•
 Collaborer avec les fonctions de soutien – Collaborer selon les besoins avec les fonctions de soutien opérationnel pertinentes (p. ex., les comptes créditeurs) pour stimuler l'efficacité opérationnelle et la valeur ajoutée maximale à l'entreprise

•
 Surveiller les cibles et les ICR – S'assurer que les cibles et les paramètres des opérations d'approvisionnement direct sur le service à la clientèle sont fournis. Suivre et surveiller ces mesures au besoin, et aggraver les problèmes au fur et à mesure qu'ils surviennent

•
 Responsabilité sociale des entreprises (RSE) – Soutenir les initiatives de RSE liées aux fournisseurs (candidats), par exemple la diversité des fournisseurs, la lutte contre la corruption, le bien-être des animaux, etc.

•
 Formation – Effectuer des activités de perfectionnement professionnel continu et assurer une formation à jour dans les processus et les systèmes pertinents au poste

Exigences:

•
 Diplôme universitaire, avec un diplôme lié à l'entreprise, de préférence une qualification d'entreprise post-universitaire

•
 Maîtrise des affaires en anglais. La compétence ou la maîtrise d'autres langues est fortement encouragée.

•
 3+ ans d'expérience en matière de passation de marchés de base, de systèmes d'entreprise et d'achats au comptant

•
 Expérience ou compréhension démontrée des programmes de réduction des coûts et d'amélioration de la valeur

•
 Expérience avec les systèmes d'entreprise et l'achat d'outils à payer et d'outils eSourcing est souhaité

•
 Bonnes compétences en communication et compréhension démontrée de la traduction des exigences opérationnelles en spécifications d'approvisionnement en ayant à l'esprit le service à la clientèle

•
 Connaissance des systèmes et des processus pour une gestion efficace de la documentation contractuelle, des modèles et des outils de traitement (p. ex., eSourcing, eAuction)

•
 Achat professionnel (p. ex. CIPS, ISM) ou licences ou certifications liées au financement

jobs.title: Java & PHP Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
For our client in Basel-Landschaft, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Java & PHP Developer.

This role involves developing and maintaining critical applications, ensuring seamless integration across systems, and supporting operational excellence.

Your Tasks:

• Design, develop, and maintain applications using Java and PHP

• Create and optimize SQL queries and database structures for high-performance systems

• Develop and manage APIs for internal and external integrations

• Administer and troubleshoot Linux-based environments

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver robust IT solutions

• Provide on-call support during agreed evenings and weekends to ensure system availability

• Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation processes

Your Profile:

• Proven experience in Java and PHP development

• Strong knowledge of advanced SQL and relational database design

• Hands-on experience with API development and integration

• Proficiency in Linux OS administration

• Proficiency in DevOps & efficient pipeline management is a plusQW

• Familiarity with cloud platforms and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

• Ability to work independently and in a team environment

• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

• Willingness to provide on-call support during evenings/weekends as per schedule

• Fluent in English, German and French is a plus
